```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U06_Alarms

1. GUI Event Graph for Alarm Detection and Command
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger alarm event
   - Verify controller detection
   - Command buzzer
   - End with buzzer active

2. GUI Event Graph for Alarm Code Enumeration and Priority Assignment
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger alarm event
   - Verify alarm code enumeration
   - Assign priority
   - End with priority assigned

3. GUI Event Graph for High Priority Alarm Display
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger high priority alarm
   - Verify display on main screen
   - Check red color and flashing
   - End with correct display

4. GUI Event Graph for Active Alarms List Display
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger alarm event
   - Press button for active alarms
   - Verify list display
   - End with correct list

5. GUI Event Graph for Alarm Legibility
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger alarm event
   - Verify display on main screen
   - Check legibility at 1 meter
   - End with correct legibility

6. GUI Event Graph for High Severity Alarm Indication
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger high severity alarm
   - Verify red color and flashing
   - End with correct indication

7. GUI Event Graph for Low Severity Alarm Indication
   - Start with GUI idle state
   - Trigger low severity alarm
   - Verify yellow color
   - End with correct indication

```
